BiblicalUsage: Hizki is a Benjamite named once, among the sons of Elpaal in the genealogy of Benjamin. He stands in the long list of the families that settled Jerusalem, a single name kept in the record of the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps the names of the families who came home, even when their story is only a line.
